name: watch-tail-hype
description: A 30-second manga-style hype video for watch-tail, drawn with p5.js
author: Ant Stanley

scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i video/watch-tail-hype-manga.mp4 -vf scale=1280:-2:flags=lanczos,fps=30 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 28 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an video/watch-tail-hype-manga-720p.mp4
